notice: SAMPLE STATEMENT, FICTIONAL PERSON. This is a developer demonstration, not a Claude proof run.

Income.why: Two observed paychecks; no assumed raise or roommate reimbursement

Rideshare.why: Plan one fewer ride when transit works

Groceries.why: Use a short shopping list; keep room for meals replacing delivery

Delivery & Takeout.why: Order about half as often; keep a delivery allowance

Restaurants & Coffee.why: Cut the weekday coffee habit in half; keep the other meals out

Subscriptions.why: Assume cancellation of standalone Hulu, Spotify, Uber One, Audible and Paramount+; confirm the listed assumptions

Shopping.why: Wait a day before optional Amazon orders; no Target refund assumed

Bank Fees & Interest.why: Use bank ATMs, request the account's fee-waiver terms, and keep the buffer; fee avoidance is an assumption

Transfers.why: Roommate reimbursement is not recurring income

Savings.why: All remaining income goes to the buffer first

Other.why: Returned payment and reversal offset; investigate what remains due

assumptions: SAMPLE STATEMENT, FICTIONAL PERSON. Developer sample, not a real Claude session.
Use the observed two-paycheck month, not an annual average or the roommate reimbursement.
Suggested cancels: standalone Hulu, Spotify, Uber One, Audible and Paramount+. Say keep Hulu (or any other) to rebuild.
Confirm the Disney bundle includes Hulu and YouTube Premium includes the music service you want. Delivery passes serve different platforms, so the choice depends on future use.
The statement does not prove a trial expired or Audible is unused. These are proposed cuts to confirm.

Apple billing may be iCloud or something else. Check iPhone Settings > your name > Subscriptions and purchase history. For iCloud+, use Settings > your name > iCloud > Manage Plan. Nothing from Apple is canceled in this plan.
For subscriptions billed by Google, use Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions. For Amazon billing, use Account > Memberships & Subscriptions.
The fictional bank's maintenance fee is assumed waivable after checking terms. The budget assumes future fee avoidance, not refunds.
The returned payment reversed in full. Confirm what the payment was for and when it must be retried; rebuild if a bill is still due.

The buffer goal of $500 is a proposed first milestone. Start from the negative statement closing balance. The allocation first restores that overdraft; only the remainder becomes a positive cushion. Check bill dates against paydays.

overdraft-nsf.action: Turn on low-balance alerts and build the buffer

maintenance.action: Check direct-deposit waiver terms or ask for a no-fee account
